items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that every point of a locally Noetherian algebraic stack has a residual gerbe (author lemma at source lines 7164-7169, label lemma-every-point-residual-gerbe-locally-Noetherian). The proof (source lines 7171-7230) replaces the stack by the quotient of a smooth groupoid with a Noetherian affine scheme of representatives, chooses in the fibre over the given point a point whose closure meets that fibre only in itself, and then uses the description of that point as a limit of the affine opens of its closure to prove that the groupoid restricted to the point agrees with the inverse image of the closure; this makes the structure morphisms of the restricted groupoid flat and locally of finite presentation, so that its quotient is an algebraic stack mapping to the original by a monomorphism and is therefore the residual gerbe (proof lines 7172-7229). The minimal point choice with the limit argument is the content. H3.
